decisions.text: The squad's fines kitty has £100k in it from late arrivals and phones in meetings. The head coach asks where it should go. The local paper always runs it when it goes to charity.

options.label: Give it to the club's community partner (press mood +2)
Put it in the transfer pot (£100k into the transfer budget)
Leave it in the kitty (nothing changes)

decisions.text: The head coach flags Cheick Moreau: his morale is down at 5, the lowest in the first team squad, and a word from the manager would help.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: Oscar Kimura (Youth) was shown a straight red against Sheffield United and is banned for 1 match. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 2 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 1 match ban stood.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
